teams.detail: Recruiting focus is shifting toward the 2028 class, with 3-star Puyallup safety Markel Newell seen as a potential first commit, even as Jedd Fisch takes over as offensive playcaller after OC Jimmie Dougherty's February departure. Season opens Sunday, Sept. 6 vs. Washington State at Husky Stadium.

Still quiet on the hardwood as Danny Sprinkle rebuilds after a 16-17 season - Croatian forward Boris Tišma's commitment and Hannes Steinbach's No. 14 selection by Charlotte in the 2026 NBA Draft remain the offseason's headline additions and departures.

Seattle held its second public training camp practice Sunday with no fresh injury news to report; WR Tory Horton practiced Saturday for the first time since his season-ending 2025 shin injury. Coach Mike Macdonald says roughly 30% of the roster has turned over as the champs defend their Super Bowl LX title.

Jalen Duren's restricted free agency standoff has reportedly gained momentum, with the Caris LeVert-for-Prince/Harris trade freeing cap room toward his 25% max (5 years, $239M); Duren's first All-NBA nod this year also makes him eligible for a 30% supermax, and league sources still see a deal landing near $200-220M before it's resolved, possibly stretching into August.

Seattle salvaged game three of its four-game set in Arlington, riding back-to-back home runs from Dominic Canzone and Randy Arozarena in the 7th to snap a two-game skid after Texas had taken the first two 5-4 and 7-1. The Mariners sit right behind the division-leading Rangers in a tight AL West race; the series finale is Monday.

headlines.headline: LEBRON JAMES SIGNS WITH THE 76ERS ON A TWO-YEAR, $8 MILLION DEAL
headlines.detail: LeBron will finish his career in Philadelphia on a stunning below-market deal, joining Joel Embiid and newly acquired Jaylen Brown; the Sixers also added Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on a buyout from Memphis this weekend.

headlines.headline: 49ERS COACH KYLE SHANAHAN WILL BE LIMITED AT TRAINING CAMP AFTER A CAR CRASH
headlines.detail: Shanahan is recovering from a July 14 crash that left him with a broken nose, ribs and hand plus a concussion; assistant Chris Foerster covers head-coaching duties as camp opens, with Shanahan expected back before the Sept. 11 opener.

headlines.headline: ARCH MANNING'S FORMER ROOMMATE PARKER LIVINGSTONE HEADLINES CAMP-WEEK TRANSFER STORYLINES
headlines.detail: Livingstone's jump from Texas to archrival Oklahoma remains one of the portal's biggest storylines as fall camps open; he caught 29 passes for 516 yards and 6 TDs as a redshirt freshman before calling the move a 'business decision.'

headlines.headline: ST. JOHN'S LOSES TRANSFER BIG DONNIE FREEMAN FOR THE SEASON TO A TORN ACHILLES
headlines.detail: Freeman, who transferred in from Syracuse after averaging 16.5 points and 7.2 rebounds last season, will miss all of 2026-27 after Achilles surgery - a major blow to Rick Pitino's roster.
